nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the Next.js frontend: installs dependencies, builds the app, and produces a minimal production runner image serving the standalone server on port 3000.
nodes.languageNotes: Three-stage build (deps, builder, runner) leverages Next.js standalone output to copy only the compiled server, public assets, and static files into a slim runtime image, minimizing final image size.

nodes.name: deps
nodes.summary: First build stage based on node:20-bookworm-slim that copies package manifests and runs npm ci to install dependencies in an isolated layer.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Build stage extending deps that injects the NEXT_PUBLIC_OUTBOUND_API_BASE build arg, copies the source tree, and runs the Next.js production build.

nodes.name: runner
nodes.summary: Final production stage on node:20-bookworm-slim that copies the built standalone server, public, and static assets, exposes port 3000, and launches the Next.js server.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list for the frontend, omitting files from the image build to keep the build context small and avoid leaking local artifacts.
